name: Ruler
description: Applies one .ruler folder of Markdown rules, MCP server settings, and skills to every coding assistant's config files, and reverts the changes on demand.

skills.name: Apply Rules
skills.description: Applies the Markdown rules in .ruler directories to the configuration files of every supported coding agent with ruler apply.

skills.name: Propagate MCP Servers
skills.description: Distributes MCP server definitions from ruler.toml into each agent's MCP config, merging with or overwriting existing entries.

skills.name: Nested Rules
skills.description: Loads nested .ruler directories so different parts of a large project get their own context-specific agent instructions.

skills.name: Revert Changes
skills.description: Reverts every change made by ruler apply, restoring backups or removing generated files, for all agents or only chosen ones.

skills.name: Gitignore Generated Files
skills.description: Keeps generated agent config files out of version control by updating .gitignore or .git/info/exclude automatically.
